caption:
In 1950 one child in four died before turning five. Today it is one in twenty-seven.

Watch the ranking change continents entirely: in 1900 it is led by Russia, Austria and Germany at over 37%; by 2024 it is Nigeria at 11.6% and Niger at 11.1%.

📊 See the share of children dying before their fifth birthday, country by country, from 1900 to 2024 in this animated ranking. Explore how the worst rates fell from above 40% to around 11%, and how reporting grew from 25 countries in 1900 to 212 today.

Source: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation and Gapminder, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0). Coverage grows with the data, so the early ranking shows the countries that counted their dead, not the worst places to be born. Between-survey years are interpolated.
